status: DRAFT, unsigned, nothing run, no data exists yet
needs_new_code: loader for the perp-live-data book.csv and markets.csv (columns in scripts/record_perps_live.py: BOOK_COLS, MARKET_COLS), audited once with its wall
event scorer plugin: one decision per ticker per minute grid point, entry at the next recorded quote, exit by hold; hand case first

declined_list_rows_checked: favourite-and-hold ban (not applicable: perps, no settlement price band)
uniqueness.difference: uses the resting book of a perpetual (top 5 levels each side), a field no candle carries; the signal is order-book pressure, not price history or trade flow
uniqueness.family_flag: none (book imbalance); a survivor is checked for correlation with perps momentum before it is called unique

data.source: perp-live-data branch, perps/live recorder (record-perps-live.yml): book.csv top 5 levels with sizes every minute, markets.csv quote, last price, marks, open interest, leverage estimates
data.ticker_names_note: exact tickers to be copied from static.csv of the first recorder file, not typed from memory
data.independence_note: forward recorder data only; no historical book exists, so nothing earlier can be scored

split.release_rule: one read, after 10 trade days and at least 100 decisions in a cell, never a running tally

holds.label: H16 perps stock and ETF perps (NVDA) forward window
holds.handling: last_decision_utc is 2026-12-21T00:00Z = 1797811200, before the hold; no NVDA decision at or after 1797897600 is scored; Auditor B to confirm MU is or is not in H16

holds.label: H17 perps30 and cash1m files
holds.handling: not used; this spec reads only the live recorder

features.imbalance: (sum bid_sz_1..5 minus sum ask_sz_1..5) / (sum bid_sz_1..5 plus sum ask_sz_1..5), from the book row at the decision minute
features.dwmid_gap: (dwmid minus last price) / (ask_px_1 minus bid_px_1); dwmid = (sum_i bid_px_i*bid_sz_i + sum_i ask_px_i*ask_sz_i) / (sum_i bid_sz_i + sum_i ask_sz_i), i = 1..5; last price from the markets row of the same minute; a row with a missing level or a crossed top is skipped and counted
features.thresholds_note: constants written now, not fitted to any recorded data

grid.subset_rationale: all cells fixed before any data exists

look_ahead.decision: book row and markets row with t_recv_ms at or before the decision minute end
look_ahead.entry: the first quote recorded after the decision minute (ask for a buy, bid for a sell), never the decision row
look_ahead.exit: the first quote at or after entry plus the hold; a missing quote within 2 minutes voids the event and counts it
look_ahead.funding: booked when a funding print falls inside the hold, from the funding file; sign positive = longs pay

costs.price_terms: return in basis points of entry price after the spread paid at entry and exit, a fee assumption of taker fee ASSUMED until Kalshi's schedule is read, haircuts two numbers 0.0002 and 0.0004 of price
costs.margin_terms: return on margin = bps x leverage_estimate for the notional at the size used (from the recorder's long_lev or short_lev at 10000), shown beside price terms, never in place of them
costs.income: decisions a day x cash edge in bps x contract value x leverage, ranked; figures by message only

tries.prior_m: read from ENGINE_TALLY.json by the engine, not typed

prediction: none positive is expected: a top-5 book on a thin perp is mostly stale or spoofed; if any cell passes, expected PF under 1.15 at the primary haircut
kill: drop the family if the first read has PF under 1.0 at the primary haircut in 5 of 7 markets
fee_form: per-order ceil(round(...)) form for binaries is not used; perps fee ASSUMED, flagged in the print
